steps.text: 'A few months ago, when I first entered university, I sent you a postcard of the National University Library.'
'I was ever so excited when I gazed upon the rows and rows of bookshelves rising to the ceiling, and when I listened to the footsteps of my classmates echo through that great building.'
'I thought there was no limit to knowledge held here, and that I could find the answer that I sought—the cure to your disease.'
'But when I stand in the same place today, I find myself in a daze. Each and every step needed to reach the bookshelves has become an arduous trek.'

'I've become afraid of the library, of the laboratories, of the classrooms. I fear giving everything my all like before. Whenever my eyes land on a passage that I cannot follow, I feel more exhausted than ever.'
'I can't help but wonder if the time I have here is enough to learn all that I want to know.'
'What if I exhaust all the knowledge here—like draining dry the Siestan sea—and I still cannot find my answer?'
'What should I do?'
—A discarded letter folded neatly into thirds at the bottom of the rubbish bin.

steps.name: Shop PA
steps.text: 'Hot Sami-style cinnamon drinks, available only during the holidays! Great for the whole family! Buy two family meals and get one free, plus a chance to draw a special Christmas Messenger surprise toy...'

steps.name: Shop PA
steps.text: 'The latest styles in the Icefield Messenger series are now in stores! Bringing warmth to your whole family...'

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: The Christmas sales have already begun? Things are always so lively in the commercial district this time of year.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: I don't think I've been to 'Miss Jacqueline's Tea Room' since Schwarz left. Sorry, Miss Jacqueline, but your towers of food are too much for me alone.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: The Roxy Department Store is just around the corner, but after visiting it with Schwarz so many times I doubt I could surprise her with any gift I purchase there.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: And over there, I should be able to hire an international Messenger directly. The lines are much longer than elsewhere, but I can send out my letter and Christmas cards there. After I buy them, of course.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Hm, I suppose I don't have to write anything on greeting card to Father.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Oh, Rinz! Good afternoon!

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: Huh? Eh? Good afternoon, Ceylon. Didn't expect to—

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: (Quietly) Why is she here? What a pain.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Is something the matter?

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: No, I was just going to say, uh... I didn't expect you to remember my name.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Hm? Do I look like I have such a bad memory? How could I forget when you're the one who taught me to tell Victorian coins apart when we first started university?

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Though, aside from payphones and the old vending machines in the hallways, I have to say I haven't found much of an opportunity to use them.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: The vending machine was made to accept old coins, but I was trying to use the new ones and it jammed. We only managed to get it fixed because you gave it a good smack.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: And then there was the first Thursday Poetry and Tea Party. You were the one who reminded me not to read Williams first because of how famous he is.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: I'm not very interested in literature, sorry.

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: Then I guess you probably remember your report on our last field expedition. The one that included so much detail that it made everyone else on the team look like we didn't contribute anything. Gave us all dreadful marks.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: Nothing. I'm just saying that I didn't really doubt your memory.

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: Are you here to shop too?

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Yes. Christmas is almost here, so I thought I would buy some presents.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Oh, but this is perfect. You're a local. Would you mind coming shopping with me?

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: I've been in Victoria for years now, but I normally only visit the large department stores. I'm not very familiar with the small boutiques hidden in the alleys.

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: Er... me?

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Sorry, were you busy with something else?

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Right, we do have a few interim reports to write before the Christmas holidays. I'd understand if you aren't in the mood for shopping.

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: No, no. I'm already half done with my reports.

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: Please, you're not the only one who does their homework before it's due.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Though, when it comes to experiments, we never have enough time, do we?

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: So what kind of gifts are you looking for? If you really don't want to waste time, we'd better be quick about it.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: I don't mind if we take our time window shopping. I need a lot of gifts. We can buy whatever catches our eyes and strikes our fancy. That's how shopping should be.

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: Huh? I, uh, didn't expect you to have the leisure to stroll around and shop.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: I simply feel I need a break today, and Christmas just happens to be the perfect excuse.

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: ...Way to kill the holiday spirit for everyone else.

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: Never mind. There's a handmade chocolate shop down these steps. Let's start there.

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: It has twenty kinds of completely different gift boxes, so you can buy all of them and give them out to different people. That ought to simplify your shopping.

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: Are you listening, Ceylon? Where has your mind drifted off to this time?

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Oh, sorry.

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: You seem rather strange today.

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: Ladies, would you like to give our new Christmas flavors a try? We have all kinds of gift boxes on sale.

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: Thanks. We were just about to take a look at some chocolates. Please, tell us more.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Hm... This sample is exquisite! Which flavor would this be?

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: Raspberry chunks with white chocolate. We have a snowfield-patterned Christmas gift box available, too.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Rinz, look! The packaging is just the color of Viviane's hair! Let's get her this.

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: Hm... hm?

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: —Did you just say you're buying Viviane a gift?

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: That's right. Are you thinking chocolates are too mundane?

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: No, I'm thinking you two had a row just the other day.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Oh, you mean the argument we had when we discussed Professor Diana's core theories during class? I already apologized to her yesterday.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: The professor's Originium experiments already have applications for civilian use, at least according to her 'Originium, Separator, and the Trembling Land' booklet, but I hadn't read it yet.

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: I mean, it wasn't just the once. You two are at each other's throats every time we meet up as a group.

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: I took you for mortal enemies.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Is that so? But she's helped me learn me so many new things. I can never thank her enough.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: There is so little that we can know on our own. To get closer to the truth, we must find those with different viewpoints and share our perspectives.

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: Oh, you...

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: That is probably the main reason I left my hometown to come study in Victoria.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: In Siesta, everyone says that the Infected will never be cured. So I decided to leave and see if people from different places and different times had different answers.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Would ancient Victoria know more than young Siesta?

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: Perhaps.

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: —Huh? Wait. Infected? Ceylon, you want to cure the Infected?

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: That's right. Do you think that's too far-fetched?

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: No wonder you chose to take the pharmaceutical college's courses as an elective, and even put your statement right in the dean's mailbox. It caused quite a ruckus.

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: The National University's pharmaceutical college is known to be particularly strict. Even if they do accept you as an audit student, they most likely won't give you any certifications.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: I'm not interested in the certificates, I just—

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: —Oh, miss? Hello. Could you help me pick two chocolate gift boxes and ring them up? Thank you.

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: Of course. Right this way.

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: *Sigh*... In the end, I never got a chance to chase her away. I even listened to her talk my ear off.

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: Maybe I should slip away now. If I stay with her any longer, I won't finish what I came here for today.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: All ready now. Where should we go next?

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: ...Perfect timing, as always.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Right, just so you know, I'm not going to buy your present today. I'm only shopping for everyone else's.

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: Huh? You were going to get me a gift? Is our relationship really—

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: (Quietly) *Sigh* If you knew what I've done, I'm sure you wouldn't think of me as a friend.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: After all, how could it be a surprise if I bought it right in front of you?

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: *Cough*... *cough*! Er, right. That's true.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Okay, please lead the way. Let's head to the next shop.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Hmm... I still haven't yet picked the most important gift, but I don't need to settle on one today. Something so important deserves some careful thought.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Aside from that, all that's left is a greeting card. Once that's done, I'll hire an international Messenger, and my mission for the day will be over.

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: More international post? You send letters home way too frequently. All those Messengers don't come cheap. Besides, won't you be heading home soon?

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: It'll take many days for me to arrive. And I think it's better to send cards than to hand them over in person.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: That reminds me. How come you haven't bought anything yourself? Have I been getting in the way of your plans? If there are any shops you want to visit, you could bring me along.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: It's almost dark. If we take any longer, they'll all be closed.

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: *Sigh* Fine... Such is my fate.

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: I want to check out the homeware shop over there. If you aren't interested, you don't have to wait for me.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Homeware? I am very interested!

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: (Quietly) ...I'd rather you weren't.

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: Hello, my name is Rinz. I placed an order at your shop yesterday. This is the order code.

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: Oh, right. Could you wrap it for me, please? This is a gift for someone else.

steps.name: Shopkeeper
steps.text: Absolutely. Here's the item you ordered. Please take a look. Would you like to include a Christmas card?

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: No, no thanks.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: What did you buy?

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: An automatic teapot. You just need to follow the instructions and put in some water and teabags. It'll keep the water at the right temperature and always make the best possible cup of tea.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: I've heard about those! Hm, I wonder what kind of Arts Unit is behind that process? Would it be okay if I opened it up to read the instructions?

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: *Sigh*. Just take it and do your research. No need to give it back, either.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Huh? I thought you were buying it as a gift?

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: Uhh...

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: It's for you.

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: You can laugh all you want. I didn't expect such a coincidence either.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Pff.

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: I'd be really happy if you made your tea with this instead of by hand when you have afternoon tea with our classmates from now on. I'm sure they'll be too.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: But Christmas is still a month away, and our holidays start in two weeks.

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: (Takes a deep breath)

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: This isn't a Christmas present. It's an apology gift.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: Please don't look at me so confused. It'll only zap what little courage I mustered to do this.

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: I'm sorry, I was scared to talk to you before.

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: Er, actually, it isn't just me. Everyone is a little scared of you.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Huh? Why would you be scared of me? ...Is it because I want to cure the Infected?

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: No, no, of course not! I didn't even know that until you mentioned it today! I just thought that you put in way too much work!

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: You come from a scorching hot city, but you climb out of bed at six to snatch yourself a seat at the library in the dead of winter! It's almost terrifying how self-disciplined you are!

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: Remember how we ran into each other in the hallway at ten this morning? I was heading to the canteen for breakfast, and you had a stack of books in your arms. When we greeted each other, I felt like your eyes were saying 'who would wake up at this hour?'

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: Anyway, your eyes are like an ice-cold mirror. Whenever I see you, I see just how lazy I am reflected back at me.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Do I really seem so cold?

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: D-Don't get the wrong idea! It's a compliment.

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: —Right, is it fine if I ask you a question?

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: Are you perhaps really close friends with an Infected?

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Eh?!

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: ...Yes, I am. She's really dear to me.

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: Is she well?

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Her condition has been very stable. Nothing can bring her down. Not even Oripathy.

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: That's good to hear.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Also, she's not in Victoria, so... the regulations here don't apply to her. If you want to—

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: No, no. I mean no ill will, and I don't think it's bizarre or anything.

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: We're Originium researchers. Any of us could one day become infected because of an accident during an experiment or observation. Perhaps even deliberately.

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: We know what it is, or at least we're closer to knowing than most.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Thank you, Rinz.

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: *Sigh*. I should be the one thanking you.

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: Just like you have a dream to cure Oripathy, which led you to come all the way to the Victorian National University, even I have a tiny dream of my own.

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: I know that all scholars dream of accomplishing what's never been done. I know we'll have to walk this road to the end before forging a new path forward on our own, but... I'm not ready for it yet.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Accomplishing what's never been done...

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: —Fortunately, I have a fine role model like you around me.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Is that so? Can... Can I really become someone like that?

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: Just take the compliment. And don't give me that look.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: No, please pay it no mind. I just thought of something else... I think I finally realized something.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Oh, and I must insist on returning your gift. We simply didn't know each other well enough. That's nothing to apologize for.

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: Uh, about that, I hadn't got to the important part yet.

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: Actually, the reason I wanted to apologize is that I was too scared of talking to you to tell you that the Originium sample we collected from the Catastrophe ground zero had a rare reaction.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: I'm not too confident in my own experimental methods and observations. I kept thinking that maybe it was nothing special and I just didn't recognize it.

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: But it'd be so embarrassing to ask you to take a look and have you tell me that to my face!

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: Which is why, even though I knew you would be more interested in its progress than any of us, I didn't dare to tell you—

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: We need to run! It's only three minutes until the next bus back to the university!

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: As long as we can sneak inside the laboratory before it closes for the day, we can stay there overnight!

steps.name: Rinz
steps.text: Er, isn't that against the rules? S-Slow down! You're going to rip my arm off!

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Master, a letter from Lady Ceylon.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: Hm? This one sure took its time to arrive. You were just about to head there to escort her back.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: Let me guess: she didn't mention me at all. As always.
Although she has already memorized its entire contents by heart, Schwarz subconsciously looks down at the letter again.

a.text: 'Since winter began, there has been a fireplace in the library that seems to run on Originium Arts. It's very pleasant to read books there now. My checkout records for this term have gotten so, so long.'

'Ever since I got to know my classmates better, I have gotten a lot of help from them too. Before, I never thought too deeply about it while searching for a cure to Oripathy, but everything that perplexed me has been resolved now.'
'Indeed, I realized how to break the code of Oripathy. Trust me, I will get there very soon.'
'I have attached a card for Father. Please hand it to him.'

steps.text: Aside from the letter, the envelope is empty. The international Messenger's postmark states that this letter was posted three days after it was signed off.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: (Lady Ceylon must have been fascinated by something else and forgot about the letter.)

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: No, Master. She wished you a happy holiday and said she is looking forward to joining you at the dining table on Christmas.
